posts.bodyHtml: Sometimes you need to remind yourself that you were the one who carried you through the heartache. You are the one who sits with the cold body on the shower floor, and picks it up. You are the one who feeds it, who clothes it, who tucks it into bed, and you should be proud of that. Having the strength to take care of yourself when everyone around you is trying to bleed you dry, that is the strongest thing in the universe.

posts.bodyHtml:
Do some breathing exercises. Take in a deep breath and exhale out all of your troubles. Feel your chest fall and rise, and remember that for every time you fall, you’ll rise up again.
Drink something warm. Drink tea. Drink hot chocolate. Let it slide down your throat and settle in your stomach like a hug from a close friend.
Close your eyes and listen to music. Listen to sad, melancholic music- the kind that grips onto your heartstrings and pulls. And then listen to bubblegum mainstream pop music. Indulge in how carefree and light the notes are. Do your silliest dance move. Shimmy a little. Let yourself be that light.
Go and sit outside on your front porch at night. Wrap yourself up in blankets and watch the cars pass. Watch the clouds break and uncover the moon. Watch airplanes fly by. Your problems are as transient as these everyday events.
Drench yourself in words of comfort. Repeat to yourself, ‘I am down but I am not defeated. I am down but I am not defeated.’ You may not be okay right now, but you eventually will be. Happiness is not about the destination, but the journey.

posts.bodyHtml:
"I loved you; even now I must confess,
Some embers of my love their fire retain;
But do not let it cause you more distress,
I do not want to sadden you again.
Hopeless and tongue-tied, yet I loved you dearly
With pangs the jealous and the timid know;
So tenderly I love you, so sincerely,
I pray God grant another love you so."
— Alexander Pushkin, “I Loved You"

posts.bodyHtml:
out of the over seven billion people in the world,

at least one

will press you up against a wall

and make love to you until your spine hurts.

it’s a small fact

but something you can carry with you

like a moon hidden away in the darkening sky

whenever you’re feeling alone.
